title: Reach conditional κ = 0.00389821 with native heights at most 524,288 and setup below 2^113
body:
One general signed multiplier reaches **conditional κ = 0.00389821** with maximum native rank **2^524288**. Its exact gain over the preceding highest complete κ of 0.0038982016137 is **83863/10000000000000**. All costs below use this same signed program, its seven installed recipes and its two physical Gaussian job types. [Written construction and complete price](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/PROOF.md) · [Exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/RESULT.json) · [Source bindings](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/SOURCES.json)

| Complete quantity | Rounded quarter packets | Dilation 79 | Frequency-weighted jobs |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| κ | 0.0038982016137 | 0.0038982 | **0.00389821** |
| Terminal ordinary heights | 60,000 and 960,000 | 35,327 and 559,005 | 8,192, 129,414 and 524,288 |
| Terminal Gaussian height | 20,000,000 | 680,000 | 483,871 |
| First full / terminal activation A | 21,020,646 / 21,020,646 | 7,437 / 1,274,851 | 7,437 / 1,146,239 |
| Ceiling for log₂ S | 513 | 228 | **113** |
| All-input ceiling for log₂ C | 21,111,681,659 | 339,787,971 | **318,259,431** |

Each height H corresponds to an internal dimension 2^H. The largest height falls 38.15-fold against the rate leader and 1.297-fold against the compact high-rate predecessor. For every input length n ≥ 2, the recurring bound is `2^318259431 n (1+log₂ n)^(1−0.00389821)` individual tape reads, writes and moves after installation. The entry tier runs locally at .00345. The stated bound pays a 514-bit surcharge for the finite interval at the global κ. A sufficient input length is `2^(ceil(2^A/6)−1)+1` significant bits. The early tier still needs 2^7412 true axes. Smaller lower-rate constructions include maximum H = 5,610 and A = 6,913 at κ = .00363005817, and A = 161,992 at κ = .00387992803556. Applying the sharper ordinary clock to the rate leader gives a comparable log₂ C ceiling of 4,726,401,730. The reported coefficients are upper bounds. [PR #8056](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8056) · [PR #8055](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8055) · [PR #8052](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8052)

An earlier weighted working configuration reached .00389820002 with maximum H = 559,011, terminal A = 1,137,207 and log₂ C ≤ 309,506,891. The final machine lowers that maximum H and raises the complete rate, at the cost of 9,032 more in terminal A and 8,752,540 more in the log₂ C ceiling. [Earlier weighted receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/776d432ddaaf9edd8f11f1b8e6933abfd82a63b7/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/RESULT.json)

The compact predecessor runs both physical copies at column widths f and 79f. The new producer runs types of widths f and 2f at birth frequencies 1 and 90. Each opening issues its own paid loans and returns its own 52,608 productive owners. The installer keeps 51 grade shares. The active calendar pays to expand 88 type-specific shares, all ordered physical owners, suspended calls, temporary zeros and their movement. At frequency 91 the total moment remains positive, but compulsory flows exceed eligible owner capacity by over 1,515. The actual 51-cell transport bounds the suffix coefficient by 7.579. This permits a real change of the lower band from 32,768 to 2,048. Charging each positive recursion depth gives a finite debit below 65081/524288. The ordinary same-stage reserve stays in its own clock. [All-size finite-loss proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/FINITE-LOSS.md) · [Typed calendar](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/typed_transport.py)

A third terminal ordinary stage buys the last rate at smaller maximum height, with all three stored recipes and suspended stages priced. For the same K7 trial and finite debit, allowing arbitrarily many ordinary stages still requires some H ≥ 517,430. The installed maximum is within 1.33% of that floor. The numerical debit separately requires H ≥ 483,870. The new complete rate exceeds the raw Gaussian trial 4286126377/2^40 in the quarter-packet comparison. These floors apply to the stated funding rules. [Formal funding, placement and rank floors](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/WeightedNumerical.lean) · [Formal Gaussian edge and depth inequalities](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/GaussianFiniteLoss.lean)

The fixed producer generates 106 sources and a 36,094,602-byte typed directory. A cold receiver restores seven data interfaces and binds five ordinary recipes and both physical Gaussian jobs to the signed operator. The linked tree occupies 38,671,319 bytes. A separate original-bootstrap installation reproduced the directory byte for byte. The two-run tape price covers source generation, the 26,267,204-byte interpreter, signed arithmetic, zero-fuel operations, stack heads, file service, transfer, initialization and cleanup. The trace-specific upper bound is below 2^113. Pricing a whole-store sweep at each instruction would give an upper bound below 2^142 on the same two flights. Actual work was reduced by the earlier quadratic compiler. Two fresh native CPython installations per version took 85.503 and 83.002 seconds for the rounded-quarter peer and 5.205 and 5.748 seconds for the weighted multiplier. The means were 84.25 and 5.48 seconds (15.38-fold). Against the earlier compact compiler, the two means were 6.16 and 6.69 seconds. These timings measure native setup. The two-flight upper bound prices the separate portable installer. [Matched measurements and exact outputs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4c1ca64c8cad0c3a72aa49f26b084222ec400dcd/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/MEASUREMENTS.json) [Reproducible fixed compiler and evidence](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/portable/EVIDENCE.json) · [Serial stack and fuel proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/portable/STACK-LOCALITY.md) · [Complete source-to-product replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/portable/README.md)

A nonzero eight-axis prefix from physical paid cut 3,418 reached helper 9,841 in the other job. Both complete physical words finished and all scratch returned to zero. The finite signed Fourier control returned −345550037539 with coefficient sequence 11811, 10996, 4152, 868, 77 and 157,248 H calls. The public small-input entry uses its scalar base. The all-size theorem retains five research premises for all-column native action, owned erasure, uniform compiler closure, fixed-tape precision and movement, and analytic recovery. The partial Lean proofs and separate leanchecker pass on 4.34.1. The full signed execution and interpreter price are written arguments. Production-rank execution, practical crossover and independent scientific acceptance remain open. [Verification and native setup measurements](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4c1ca64c8cad0c3a72aa49f26b084222ec400dcd/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/VERIFICATION.md) · [Nonzero interior transfer](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier/check_nested.py)
